title: Technical Marketing Engineer
text:
About Us
Selector is building an AI-driven network observability platform. By adopting an AI/ML-based analytics approach, the platform provides actionable multi-dimensional insights to network, cloud, and application operators. It enables operations teams to meet their KPIs through seamless collaboration, search-driven conversational user experience, and automated data engineering pipelines.
Our solutions are used by leading Telecoms, Media Providers, Retail, and Professional Sports organizations across the world. Our novel approach and rapidly expanding footprint put us in the unique position for continued growth to become a category leader. To fuel our growth, we are seeking passionate, high-energy, results-oriented individuals to join our team.
Our mission is to deliver world-class solutions on behalf of the large enterprise. Supported by leading investors, Selector is uniquely positioned to deliver a world-class solution to address large enterprise requirements across the globe. 
Selector offers a discretionary PTO policy, health insurance, 401k, the opportunity for a bonus, and more.
Position Summary:
As a Technical Marketing Engineer (TME), you will be the bridge between our high-level product strategy and the deep technical reality of our users. You aren't just a marketer; you are a power user, a storyteller, and a technical expert. You will be responsible for creating the "proof" that our platform solves real-world problems for network engineers.
Key Responsibilities:

Technical Content Creation: Develop high-quality technical assets including deep-dive white papers, reference architectures, technical blogs, and detailed "how-to" guides.

Demo Excellence: Build, maintain, and script world-class demo environments. You will ensure our sales engineering team has the best "sandboxes" to showcase our ML-driven insights.

Competitive Intelligence: Stay ahead of the AIOps landscape. Conduct hands-on lab testing of competing products to create "Why Selector" technical battlecards.

"How-To" Series: Build and record a library of snackable technical tutorials designed to reduce time-to-value for new users.

AI-Assisted Development: Utilize modern AI coding tools (like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Replit) to rapidly prototype custom front-end dashboards and visualization layers.

Industry Expertise: Stay up-to-date on the latest networking technologies, industry trends (e.g., AIOps, Network Automation, SASE, SD-WAN), and competitor products.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Engineering, or a related field. MBA is a plus.

5+ years of engineering experience

Modern Dev Workflow: Proficiency with Cursor or similar AI-augmented IDEs to accelerate the creation of React, Vue, or Tailwind-based front-end demos.

Creative Suite: Familiarity with video capture and editing tools (e.g., Camtasia, Loom, Descript, or Adobe Premiere).

Networking & Ops Core: You must speak the language of the persona—BGP, gNMI, Flow data, and OpenConfig should be second nature.

Strong analytical skills and the ability to use data to inform decisions.

A self-starter who can thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

What We Offer:

Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.

Comprehensive health, dental, and vision benefits.

unlimited weeks of paid time off, plus company holidays.

A dynamic and collaborative work environment with a focus on professional growth.

Opportunity to work on cutting-edge technology and make a significant impact on the company's success.

title: Full Stack Engineer
text:
As a Full Stack Engineer, you’ll join a Cloud Engineering organization where engineers are encouraged to think beyond traditional frontend and backend boundaries. You’ll have the opportunity to own meaningful features end to end, work across different layers of the stack, and contribute to products and infrastructure used at scale.
We are also actively evolving how software is built in the AI era. You’ll work in an environment where AI-assisted development is part of the engineering process, with room to experiment with new tools, workflows, and ways of delivering software faster without compromising quality.
This is an opportunity to have real technical ownership, influence how we build, and grow beyond a single engineering discipline while working with experienced teams across Frontend, Backend, Platform and QA.
Location:This role is 100% remote as long as you’re in the EET or Central Europe time zone +/- 2 hours.
Interview Process: 4 stages - HR conversation ➡️ Values/Technical discussion ➡️ Live Technical interview ➡️ Home Assignment 
Technologies: Python, Golang, TypeScript, NextJS, JavaScript, Kubernetes, Docker, Microservices
Reporting to: Frontend Tech Lead & Frontend Manager
Your team: You’ll join a team of 8 colleagues, (1 Manager, 1 Tech Lead, 5 Senior Developers, YOU!)
What will make your journey with us amazing?
A supportive manager who cares about your well-being and is invested in your professional growth.
A culture of continuous learning, with clear targets and feedback.
A global company with over 2500 employees located in more than 26 countries around the world, including offices in 3 countries: Ukraine, Portugal, and India.
What will you do:

Build and maintain customer-facing features across frontend applications and backend services.

Design and integrate APIs that support reliable, scalable product experiences.

Own features end to end, from technical design and implementation through testing and deployment.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver initiatives.

Use AI-assisted development tools to accelerate implementation while reviewing, validating, and improving generated code.

Improve code quality, performance, reliability, and maintainability across the systems you contribute to.

What will you bring:

Strong professional experience building modern web applications across the full stack, with particular depth in backend engineering.

Advanced knowledge of Python and/or Golang, with hands-on experience designing and building backend services, REST APIs, and databases.

Solid experience with Docker and Kubernetes, and comfort operating and deploying services in containerized environments.

Experience with microservices architectures and building systems that scale reliably under increasing load and traffic.

Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and modern frontend frameworks such as NextJS, with the ability to build and maintain customer-facing features.

Ability to design, implement, test, and troubleshoot features across the full application stack.

Experience using AI coding tools or agents as part of the development workflow, with the ability to review, validate, and improve AI-generated solutions.

Strong software engineering fundamentals, including testing, code quality, performance, security, scalability, and maintainable system design.

What’s in it for you:
Embrace a 100% remote lifestyle with this opportunity!
Work with flexibility in a supportive environment where you have the autonomy to manage your time, while also staying connected with the team through daily check-ins and shared office hours. We value collaboration and commitment to team goals, balancing independence with structured support to ensure we all succeed together.

Invest in your growth with dedicated learning resources and support.

Thrive in a culture rooted in truth, trust, and transparency.

Unleash your creativity and explore new ideas with 2 dedicated R&D days each month!

title: Product Engineer
text:
Shape the Future on Autopilot

At Autopilot, you won’t just write code - you’ll shape the product. As a Product Engineer, you’ll own features end-to-end and help redefine what’s possible in fintech.
We’re building a high-performance, AI-native Fintech Operating System designed to optimize cost and revenue for digital businesses. Join us on a multi-year mission to build smarter infrastructure for commerce.
Why Join Us?
You’ll help build an ambitious product from the ground up, with a team that values speed, craft, and autonomy. If you’re ready to make an outsized impact in fintech, we’d love to meet you.
About the Role
You'll join a fast-moving team building modern web applications that process and optimize financial data at scale. This is a full-stack role with strong emphasis on backend engineering:
🛠️ What You'll Do

Build scalable backend services in NodeJS

Develop responsive UIs with React Router v7

Collaborate on API design

Write clean, well-tested code across the stack

Optimize database queries and data pipelines (PostgreSQL)

Improve observability, monitoring, and infrastructure

Contribute to architectural decisions and engineering practices

🎯 What We're Looking For

5+ years of experience in product-focused engineering

Strong ownership mindset and startup readiness

Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, tRPC and OpenAPI

Comfortable with React + TypeScript for cross-functional work

🌟 Bonus Points

Payments or fintech experience

Exposure to Clickhouse/Tinybird

Exposure to AI/ML systems

Built high-performance, low-latency systems

Experience with tRPC/OpenAPI

Our Hiring Process
We focus on real-world skills - not whiteboard tricks. Here's what to expect:

Apply with LinkedIn Profile And Resume

We'll filter candidates based on the requirements listed above which you will receive an email to schedule a 60-minute live coding session with us once you get super productive with our interview repository.

60-Minute Live Coding Session

You'll pair with one of our engineers to build a small, production-like feature using full-stack TypeScript React.

We’ll look at:

How you think through product requirements

How you model data and structure code

Your testing, naming, and documentation habits

How you handle edge cases and incomplete specs

The session mirrors our actual development workflow: 

accessible

pragmatic

collaborative

Technical Review & Feedback

After the session, we’ll walk through your code together. You'll get feedback from us, and we’ll discuss your decisions, trade-offs, and any areas for improvement.

Culture & Alignment Chat

A final call with CEO to discuss your long-term goals, how you work best, and whether Autopilot is the right fit for both sides.

title: L2 DevOps Engineer
text:
Summary: We are seeking an experienced L2 DevOps Engineer with over 5+ years of experience to design, implement, and manage infrastructure and deployment pipelines across hybrid environments, including on-premises data centers and cloud platforms. This role requires expertise in AWS, Azure, Kubernetes, IaC, CI/CD, and monitoring tools, along with strong troubleshooting and security practices. You will work closely with development, QA, and operations teams to ensure reliable, scalable, and secure delivery of enterprise-grade applications, while also mentoring junior team members and driving automation initiatives.

 

Responsibilities:

Manage and support hybrid infrastructure, including physical data centers and AWS/Azure services.

Design and implement Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, and Helm; manage GitOps deployments with ArgoCD/Flux.

Configure and maintain Kubernetes clusters (EKS), ensuring scalability and high availability.

Build, maintain, and optimize CI/CD pipelines with Jenkins, GitLab CI, Bitbucket, and GitHub.

Automate deployments, scaling, and monitoring processes.

Set up and maintain observability using Grafana, Prometheus, and other monitoring tools.

Perform root cause analysis of performance issues and participate in on-call support.

Manage SSL/TLS and code signing certificates and implement best practices for infrastructure security.

Work with cross-functional teams to improve infrastructure reliability and delivery processes.

Maintain clear documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing and incident post-mortems.

Required Skills & Experience:

5+ years of experience in DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering, or related roles.

Strong hands-on expertise with AWS and Azure cloud services.

Solid experience with Infrastructure-as-Code tools and GitOps.

Proven experience with Kubernetes/EKS setup and operations.

Proficiency in CI/CD pipelines and GitOps practices.

Strong knowledge of monitoring and observability tools and incident/on-call management.

Scripting and automation skills in Python, TypeScript, and Bash/shell.

Good understanding of networking, Linux/Windows Server administration, and troubleshooting.

Experience with data streaming and CDC pipelines and administering relational and in-memory data stores.

Configuration management and server automation experience with SaltStack and/or Ansible.

Experience managing SSL/code signing certificates and understanding of security best practices and compliance frameworks.

Soft Skills:

Strong problem-solving and root cause analysis capabilities.

Excellent communication and documentation skills.

Ability to collaborate in weekly/bi-weekly team meetings and contribute to on-call rotations.

Mentoring and knowledge-sharing mindset.
